relevance_note: Case report of two brothers with arterial tortuosity syndrome, the first with two SLC2A10 variants: "two heterozygous variants of SLC2A10 gene c.1057_1058delCT (p. L353Tfs*8) and c.912 T > G (p.C304W) were detected".
method_note: Read by hand; a Python script in the scratch directory only assembled the JSON and checked spans and fields. Six in-scope people: the first fetus/older brother (unnamed person 1; genetically confirmed), the second fetus/brother (unnamed person 2; not genetically tested, ATS 'highly suspected'; no variant row), the mother and father (each a stated heterozygous carrier of one variant, Table 1 'Origin' column), and a previously published antenatal case from reference [9] (homozygous p.S81R) and that patient's mother ('mother was the same variant'). Abdulmohsen et al.'s 7 patients are group-level only and get no rows. The paper never calls either brother a proband, so is_proband is null for all. Gestational ages (29 and 22 weeks of gestation) are recorded as onset text with no ISO duration because they are prenatal. Age at diagnosis for unnamed person 1 is the age at which WES was performed. Genomic positions come from Table 1 column 'Location of the HG19'. The paper calls the frameshift a 'code shift mutation'; recorded as frameshift. Ref [9] patient's inheritance recorded as 'inherited maternal' from 'mother was the same variant' although the patient is homozygous (the father is not mentioned); the gene is printed 'SCL2A' and recorded as printed. Pulmonary artery and aortic stenosis are marked excluded for both brothers from the Discussion sentence 'it’s similar with our cases just elongated and tortuous there was no stenosis noted', read as being about 'our cases'; this reading is uncertain. 'Normal growth and development' for unnamed person 1 is recorded as excluded growth abnormality and developmental delay (D-27). The prenatal statement 'without any extra-cardiac abnormalities' is recorded as excluded but not used for the checklist, because later postnatal features (cutis laxa, facial features) were reported; this is a time difference rather than a contradiction. Left and right ventricular wall thickening on postpartum CT is mapped to the checklist item ventricular hypertrophy. Facial features for unnamed person 2 are reported only generically. The abstract says variants were detected 'in newborn and their father and mother'; the Table 1 note says 'Targeted exome sequencing that included 5,177 genes' while the text says whole exome sequencing (method inconsistency, noted). The abstract and Discussion postpartum CT/CTA descriptions are not attributed to unnamed person 2 because the text only names the first case for CTA.
